launches.title: Vyra - Personal video editing agent for shortform content
launches.body:
**TL;DR: We let you edit videos on your phone without you needing to touch a timeline or manually edit anything. Just upload your raw footage, prompt, and let it cook! No setup or plugins needed. We've already pulled 40M+ views on Vyra-edited content** :)

[**https://youtu.be/njap7VrFuXY**](https://youtu.be/njap7VrFuXY)

**Hey YC! We're** [Sulan Zhang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sulan-zhang) **and** [Caleb Pong](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cjpong) from [@Vyra](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/36411) ([usevyra.com](https://www.usevyra.com/)).\
Sulan’s a creator with 80k followers ([@sulansart](https://www.instagram.com/sulansart/)) who started out posting painting videos on Instagram. Caleb has been a video editor for 7 years and previously built plugins for Adobe and DaVinci Resolve. As a creator + editor team, we both hated how tedious editing was: scrubbing, captions, overlays, and effects…it would take hours, even just for one short-form video. So a year ago, we started building Vyra!

Now every video we post is edited in the Vyra mobile app, like [this](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdcjJBPva-m/) storytelling video about YC. We spend a few minutes prompting and then let Vyra edit autonomously. We’ve already amassed over **40M views** on Vyra-edited content, from personal brand videos to high-volume UGC - and we can’t wait to see you start pulling views too.

Our high-volume UGC:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125706&key=user_uploads/3090217/04a256af-a31c-40c2-a1bd-e1a3b2054eb7)

**Why this matters for you**

Every founder should be posting content: product demos, weekly updates, talking-head reels. Most of us don't do it because editing is a pain, but now, with Vyra, it’s so easy, and you'll actually post consistently :)

**What Vyra does**

* Edits everything for you from a prompt
* Pulls reference videos directly from Instagram or TikTok so it matches the style you want
* Puts everything on a timeline so you can do final touches yourself (if you want)
* Stores all your footage so you can smart-search your whole library
* Batch edits high-volume UGC videos via our MCP

**Our ask**

* **Download the app and try it:** <https://www.usevyra.com/go/bflaunch> (or if you prefer editing on desktop / via MCP, sign up [here](https://www.usevyra.com/))
* **Want help with content strategy or going viral?** Let’s chat! Would love to share our learnings and hear about how you’re looking to post content: [**https://calendly.com/sulan-usevyra/20min-chat**](https://calendly.com/sulan-usevyra/20min-chat)
* **Know a founder or team that should be posting more?** Tag them below :D
